main_text.p: חרך Chald. Adussit, Ambussit, Inussit, in Targum frequens: Hithp. Præterit. לא התחרך Non fuit adustus, Dan.3.27. Hebraicè Futurum ex Kal, לא יחרך Non aduret, assando scil. Prov.12.27.
חרכים m.p. Clathri, Cancelli, Cant.2.9. significatio etiam Chaldaica est. Nam חרכא Fenestra, idem quod Hebraicè חלון.
חרול m. Urtica, Soph.2.9. תחת חרול Sub urticis, Job.30.7. Aben Esra & R.Levi, Sub spinis: Plural. חרלים Urticæ, Prov.24.31.

חרם Hiph. החרים Anathematizavit, Anathemate vel Anathemati, Internecioni, Perditioni devovit, Disperdidit: Consecravit, Devotum effecit: Præter. החרים אותם Internecioni devovit eos, Jos.11.v.12. והחרמתי ליהוה Et anathemate devovebo quæstum eorum Domino, Mich.4.13. Futur. בל חרם אשר יחרם Omne devotum, quod devoverit quis Domino, Lev. 27. v.28. פן תחרימו Ne anathemazite, id est, ne rapite vel attingite anathema, ut Kimchi explicat, Josua 6. v.18. Alii passivè, Ne fiatis anathema, vel, Ne efficiatis vos ipsos anathema. Hoph. Futur. יחרם Ut anathema perditor, Exod.22.20.

חרם vel חרם m. Devotum, Res devota, Anathema: כל חרם Omne devotum, Num.18.14. והחרם Et anathema non erit amplius, Zach.14.11. Cum quinq; punctis, est etiam Sagena, Plagæ, Rete: יצידו חרם Venantur plagis, Mich.7.2. Aff. בחרמו Plagis suis, Hab.1.15. על עם חרמי Super populum anathematis mei, quem scil. internecioni devovi, Jos.34.5. Plural. מצודים וחרמים Retia & plagæ, Eccles.7.27.
חרום m. Curtus membris, Levit.21.18. & opponitur ipsi שרוע Superfluus membris, aut habens unum altero majus,

page.notes: Hebrew is transcribed in consonantal letters; the vowel points visible in the scan are not reproduced. Long s has been normalised to plain s throughout. The large headwords (חרך, חרכים, חרול, חרם, חרם, חרום) are set in display type at the left margin and are included as the opening words of their entries. Some small Hebrew forms in the Hebrew-letter citations, especially in the entry for חרם, are slightly blurred and should be checked against the original.
